title: write_result emits a route record carrying the actually-routed provider/exit
notes: GREEN: the operatord seam appends kind:route_record at result write (and at envelope write — see test_route_records.py for the kill-mid-run half). RED: no route record, so route truth is unprovable. gate_replay mode: the driver exercises the REAL scheduler/dispatcher/ledger seams inside the sandbox HARNESS_DIR. GREEN env sets SOLAR_GATE_LEDGER=1 (the Lane 3 fix); RED injects SOLAR_GATE_LEDGER=0 (the pre-contract world) and the same expect must fail — proving the scenario discriminates the class, not the plumbing.
